runs.question: Which projects involve researchers from at least two countries, and how many countries does each involve?

action.objective: Count countries per project (multinational teams)
action.query:
SELECT ?project ?projectLabel (COUNT(DISTINCT ?country) AS ?countryCount)
WHERE {
  ?person <https://spinach.local/participatesIn> ?project .
  ?person <https://spinach.local/worksAt> ?lab .
  ?lab <https://spinach.local/locatedIn> ?city .
  ?city <https://spinach.local/country> ?country .
  OPTIONAL { ?project rdfs:label ?projectLabel }
}
GROUP BY ?project ?projectLabel
HAVING (COUNT(DISTINCT ?country) >= 2)
ORDER BY ?project
